resources.string: Tips are on the Play Store version

Enable this plugin in Torque → Settings → Plugins.

Allow notifications when asked. Set Unrestricted battery so Torque can start this plugin in the background.

With Write corrected % onto Torque Fuel Level (012F) enabled, the corrected percent is written onto Torque’s stock Fuel Level (012F).
Write corrected % onto Torque Fuel Level (012F)
Battery/background start was denied. Open once so the plugin can run with Torque.

Add additional tanks as needed (stock tank 1 always stays). Do not switch senders onto the PCM FLI pin (false fill). Each extra tank needs its own Torque extra PID (MCU Mode 22, unique name — not 012F or Ford 16C1). Select-PID value is the 1-based tank id. Gal/hr is charged only to the active tank.
